items.t: Loose timing-case dowel pin ("killer dowel pin")
items.job: Install killer dowel pin retaining tab kit

items.t: VP44 injection pump failure (weak lift pump)
items.job: Replace VP44 injection pump and lift pump

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or losing overdrive (47RE)
Dashboard top cracks and crumbles
items.job: Fit a molded dash top cover or replace the dash pad
items.note: Owners report an average of about $500.

items.t: Hood can open unexpectedly (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Clutch fluid line can leak onto the exhaust (recall)
items.job: Replace or reroute hydraulic clutch line (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver air bag can be disabled by the clockspring (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Violent front-end shake ("death wobble")
items.job: Replace front track bar (the most common worn part)
items.note: Parts and install time from AmericanTrucks track bars (about 2–3 hours). Worn tie rods, ball joints or a drag link add cost, so the final bill depends on the inspection.

items.t: Left tie rod can break (recalls)
items.job: Replace left tie rod and align (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: 48RE automatic slipping or failing
Common-rail fuel injector wear
items.note: Owners of 2006 trucks report about $3,000.

items.t: Truck can roll out of Park (recall)
items.job: Install out-of-Park alarm and software update (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor clutch or compressor, or repair its power circuit
items.note: Owners report an average of about $800. Power-circuit fixes cost far less than a compressor.

items.t: Takata front air bag inflator can rupture (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: EGR cooler leaking coolant into the engine
items.note: Parts: Grizzly reman $688 (plus $200 core) to Mopar 68048991AA $2,226. AmericanTrucks lists about 2 hours to install; allow extra time for coolant refill and bleeding.

items.t: Diesel particulate filter clogging and fuel in the oil
items.job: Replace diesel particulate filter (if cleaning and a forced regen don't work)
items.note: Parts: aftermarket DPF $1,895 to Mopar 68035061AB $3,277 (plus core), 2007.5–2012. AmericanTrucks lists about 1 hour. Many trucks only need a forced regeneration and an oil change.

items.t: Variable-geometry turbo sticking
items.note: Parts: BD Diesel stock-replacement HE351VE $1,950 to genuine Holset $2,455 (each plus a $500 core). BD lists a 5-hour install. A sticking vane can sometimes be cleaned or the actuator replaced for less.

items.t: High-output alternator can fail suddenly (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: DEF / SCR system faults and NOx sensor failures
items.note: Parts: Dorman downstream sensor $385 to Mopar reman $546 (2013–2018 fit). AmericanTrucks lists about 30 minutes. A DEF pump, heater or SCR catalyst fault costs more and depends on diagnosis.

items.t: Water pump can leak coolant (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Drag link nut can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure drag link nut (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Tailgate can open while driving (recalls)
items.job: Replace tailgate actuator or align strikers (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Hemi lifter and camshaft wear
Side curtain air bag inflator can rupture (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Recall repair: replace CP4 pump with CP3 and fuel parts as needed
items.note: Free at the dealer for covered 2019–2020 trucks. Diesel World reports out-of-pocket CP4 failure repairs start around $6,000 and can pass $10,000.

items.t: Transmission fluid can spray from the dipstick tube (recalls)
items.job: Replace transmission dipstick and vent assembly (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Intake air heater relay can short and start a fire (recalls)
items.job: Replace intake heater relay and fuse (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver air bag may not deploy because of the steering column module (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: High beams or turn signals act up (recall)
items.job: Replace or reprogram steering column control module (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Instrument cluster display can go blank (recalls)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Trailer lights and trailer brakes may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace or update trailer tow module (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake warning light can show wrongly (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ram dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.
